title: Nourishing Syrian Lentil Wrap
description: A flavorful and healthy Syrian dish featuring lentils, chimichurri sauce, and a deglaze fond, all wrapped in a ti leaf, perfect for a weeknight dinner
instructions: Rinse the lentils and cook them in boiling water until they are tender
Heat olive oil in a pan over medium heat and saute the onions until they are translucent
Add the garlic to the pan and cook for 1 minute
Add the chimichurri sauce to the pan and stir to combine
Deglaze the pan with lemon juice and scrape up any browned bits
Add the cooked lentils to the pan and stir to combine with the chimichurri sauce
Season the lentil mixture with salt and black pepper
Warm the ti leaves by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20 seconds
Assemble the wraps by spooning the lentil mixture onto a ti leaf and topping with parsley
Serve the wraps immediately and enjoy
